test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Into how many constituencies was India divided for the 2019 Lok Sabha elections?
solution:
The correct answer is __**543**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **For the purpose of constituting the Lok Sabha, the whole country has been divided into 543 Parliamentary Constituencies. Hence, Option 1 is correct.**
 
• Each one of the** constituencies elects one member.**
 
• The **members of the Lok Sabha** are** elected directly by the eligible voters.**
 
• In January 2020, the** Anglo-Indian reserved seats in the Parliament and State Legislatures of India were abolished by the 104th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019.**
 
• **131 seats** are reserved for** representatives of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in Lok Sabha.**
 
• Some seats are reserved in **Lok Sabha for the members of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.**
 
• As per the order issued by the **Delimitation Commission in 2008, 412 are general**, **84 seats are reserved for Scheduled Castes, and 47 seats for the Scheduled Tribes.**
 
• Earlier it was** 79 and 41 for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes **respectively. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Speaker of Lok Sabha is elected by Members of Lok Sabha.
 
• He is elected by members of Lok Sabha from amongst its members, as soon as, after the first meeting. 
 
• He remains in his office during the life of the Lok Sabha. He vacates office earlier in any of the following cases: 
 
 
• If he ceases to be a member of Lok Sabha; 
 
• If he resigns by writing to the Deputy Speaker; and 
 
• If he is removed by a resolution passed by a majority of all the members of the Lok Sabha. 
 
 
 
• Such a resolution can be moved only after giving 14 days' advance notice.
 
• He maintains order and decorum in the House for conducting its business. 
 
• He adjourns the House to suspend the meeting in the absence of a quorum (presence of only 1-10th of the total strength of the House). 
 
• He does not vote in the first instance, but he can exercise a casting vote in the case of a tie (deadlock)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• The **maximum strength of the Lok Sabha** can be 552 members.
 
• Out of these **552 members, 530 members are elected from the States, and 20 members are elected from the Union Territories.**
 
• **President** has the **power to summon or prorogue the Houses of Parliament and to dissolve the Lok Sabha.**
